'''Robas''' were large [[Swine|pig]] beasts native to the planet [[Aralia/Legends|Aralia]]. A roba's average adult weight was nine hundred kilograms.

[[File:Roba_SWG.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A roba on Talus.]]
Robas were the favored prey of the [[Ranat/Legends|Ranats]], who used hit-and-run tactics to [[Death/Legends|kill]] them. Packs of Ranats would chase them, making swift, flesh-ripping attacks with their large tusks to weaken the robas and quickly retreating. Eventually, the weakened beasts would fall, and the Ranats would move in for the kill.

Robas were rare on Aralia, possibly due to overhunting by the Ranats.

On [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]], they were farmed for their meat and were presumably the source of [[Roba steak/Legends|roba steak]].

Wild robas could also be found on the planet [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] and the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="SWG" />
